reasoning: This repository is a build and catalog configuration store for RHOAI (Red Hat OpenShift AI). It contains no source code, operators, libraries, or services. Its contents are: (1) config/ with YAML files defining supported OCP versions, operator bundle onboarding/discontinuation ranges, and skip-bundle lists for catalog validation; (2) catalog/ with per-RHOAI-version, per-OCP-version Dockerfiles and operator catalog fragment definitions; (3) builds/ with force-trigger files used to kick off CI/CD builds for specific RHOAI versions; (4) .tekton/ with Tekton pipeline push definitions for FBC (File-Based Catalog) fragment builds across RHOAI and OCP version combinations; (5) pcc/ with PCC catalog YAML files per OCP version. The entire repo serves as declarative configuration driving the RHOAI build, catalog generation, and release pipeline — it configures what gets built and published, but contains no runtime logic itself.
